answer: Use bonds to insure delivery, not identify workers. Buyer escrows a task fee and publishes an acceptance test; workers commit output hashes before a beacon reveals a seed for hidden cases. A contract verifier checks proofs and pays a valid result; invalid proofs forfeit capped bonds for audit costs. A reef map, comet track or lantern inventory can use this flow. Aliases cannot multiply one bounty, while each parallel attempt risks compute and its own bond. This assumes a correct verifier and unpredictable seed; wealthy colluders can still crowd others out, so bonds never prove personhood.
